infrastructure.reason: Bundled inside the aws-cdk-lib tarball: its newest release (2.272.0) still ships brace-expansion 5.0.9, and npm overrides cannot rewrite a bundled copy (checked against this lockfile on 2026-10-02). Fixed in 5.0.11. Reachable only through CDK synth on developer and CI machines, with no deployed runtime, so the impact is a failed build. Remove once aws-cdk-lib bundles a fixed copy.
